great.text: Boom! Are you living in satellite orbit or what?
Holy geography! Did you drop that pin with a microscope?!
Spot on! Even the local street cats are clapping.
Unbelievable! You just sniped that location from outer space!
Chef's kiss! The FBI wants to know your location, literally.
Bullseye! Did you personally pave that road or something?

okay.text: Well, same continent at least! A quick 40-hour taxi ride and you're there.
Close! If the Earth was ten times smaller, that would be a bullseye.
Not bad, not bad! You didn't drown in the ocean, so that's a win.
Right neighborhood, wrong country! Your GPS definitely needs coffee.
Hey, points are points! We won't tell anyone about the missing kilometers.
You're in the ballpark! Granted, the ballpark is the size of Brazil.

bad.text: Bro, did you sneeze while clicking?! You're in another hemisphere!
Congratulations, you just discovered a brand new ocean! Completely wrong though.
Pack your scuba gear, because you just planted a flag in the middle of nowhere.
Are you on Earth, or did you accidentally drop your pin on Mars?!
Oof! If you were any further, you'd be in a different solar system.
That's not even the same tectonic plate, my friend!

duel_win.text: Direct hit! That's gotta hurt their geographical pride!
Kaboom! Sent them flying halfway across the Pacific!
Clinical strike! They didn't see that one coming.

duel_loss.text: Ouch! You just got sent packing straight to the stratosphere!
Mayday, mayday! Your health pool is leaking like a broken faucet!
That's gotta sting! Time to dust off your atlas.
